title: METEO
summary: Live weather for anywhere on Earth: an animated sky that matches the conditions, a 24-hour timeline, a 10-day outlook, air quality and a rain radar.
overview: METEO started as my first Next.js project and was rebuilt from scratch on Next.js 16. It runs on free, keyless Open-Meteo data, paints the backdrop to match the real sky (rain, snow, stars, storms), and adds city search, an animated precipitation radar, air quality, UV, sun and moon tiles, and °C/°F units.
highlights: Canvas sky that renders the live weather: rain, snow, stars, clouds and lightning.
⌘K city search with recent places and one-tap geolocation.
Animated RainViewer precipitation radar on a MapLibre basemap.
Hourly temperature curve, 10-day range bars, air quality, UV, wind, sun and moon tiles.
